versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the multi-platform publisher agent.
- Supports automated publishing of books to multiple platforms including Amazon KDP, 番茄小说, 起点中文网, 晋江文学城, Royal Road, and 七猫小说.
- Handles content format adaptation, sensitive word replacement, and custom cover generation per platform requirements.
- Provides account management, publishing scheduling (immediate/timed/serial), and status feedback for all platforms.
- Integrates legal CAPTCHA solving via third-party services for publishing automation.
- Records and returns book IDs, review status, and exception logs for analytics and monitoring.
